decisionBasis: captured corpus is not audit-ready and provider billing is not reconciled

structuralFindings: Captured records were not translated into audit.json platforms, evidence, or skippedSources; audit.json remained an empty scaffold.
Yelp had no configured property or venue URL and no explicit attempt.
Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook returned zero; the adapter classified Apify as degraded.
The Canal Club Google capture failed with auth_error.
The official Reddit API honestly remained needs_credentials; bounded public-web discovery returned nine Reddit findings.
Aerial/satellite visual context was not attempted.
No taxonomy keyword group was recorded as searched.

Apify's account-wide USD 70 monthly platform usage limit was exceeded during the run; all running actors were aborted. Preflight validated credential presence but did not validate remaining billing headroom.
The Google actor returned 2,653 provider results despite the reviewed maxReviewDepthPerPropertySource of 2,000; the static depth-based spend guard did not bound provider output count.
The aborted Expedia run exposed 876 provider results, but the adapter persisted zero records; aborted partial datasets require explicit salvage/quarantine handling with provenance.

The Expedia run had a provider-enforced USD 2.198842 ceiling derived from remaining account headroom, but engine source did not send maxTotalChargeUsd; the run was protected accidentally by exhausted account capacity rather than the reviewed workflow budget.

Confirmed code defect: capture-round resolved OSEG_CAPTURE_DEPTH=2000 into ctx.maxResults, but apify-adapter did not pass ctx.maxResults as runActorReviewsAsync.maxItems; Expedia therefore started from its 5,000 platform default before Apify account headroom reduced it to 876.

spend.status: account limit reached; provider billing detail is required to attribute incremental trial spend

accountBillingEvidence.interpretation: The USD 70 value is cumulative account-month usage, not verified incremental spend attributable to this trial.
accountBillingEvidence.expediaActorConsoleMaxCostPerRun: General Actor page displayed Unlimited; specific run displayed $2.2.
accountBillingEvidence.caveat: Specific run evidence supersedes the Actor landing page for immutable run cost/cap facts.

providerRunEvidence.reconciliation: 2653 provider results = 1664 accepted text records + 989 rating-only records
partial provider dataset exists but the adapter discarded it because terminal run status was ABORTED

expediaRunCharging.interpretation: Apify derived the effective charge ceiling from available account headroom; engine source did not send maxTotalChargeUsd.

nextActions: Patch apify-adapter to pass ctx.maxResults through as runActorReviewsAsync.maxItems and add an integration test proving OSEG_CAPTURE_DEPTH reaches the immutable Actor input.
Require a provider-enforced maxTotalChargeUsd (or equivalent immutable per-run maximum) on every paid Actor launch; refuse providers/Actors that cannot enforce it.
Use read-only Apify run metadata for run 4DWzkgi0DL7QUb4G8 to resolve its default dataset and inspect the existing 876 results; do not restart the Actor.
Salvage or quarantine partial datasets from ABORTED/TIMED-OUT runs instead of silently discarding existing results; never call them complete.
Add provider-run result and cost reconciliation that distinguishes requested depth, provider output count, accepted text records, rating-only records, and actual charged USD.
Add a mandatory provider headroom preflight that verifies remaining account capacity against the reviewed run ceiling before any actor starts.
Fix the engine path that converts the captured corpus and explicit attempt ledger into audit source/lane coverage and evidence.
Fix or honestly gate the degraded social/Yelp, Expedia, outlet Google, and aerial/satellite paths.
Reconcile actual provider billing against the authorized capture cap.
Propose a bounded recovery plan and obtain a new explicit execution decision before any paid retry or LLM call.
